column4: The S-1 says Anthropic was founded on the belief that the most consequential technology demands an organisation committed to capability and safety
column6: was founded by a team of researchers who believe that the most consequential technology in history demands an organization structurally committed to both capability and safety

column4: The S-1 says frontier research is required to build the most capable and safest AI systems
column6: sustained, focused research at the frontier of intelligence is required to build the most capable and safest AI systems

column4: The S-1 says its team is united by the conviction that the technology requires the most talented team
column6: united by the conviction that the most consequential technology in history requires the most talented team building it.

column4: The S-1 names Anthropic's call for pacing the frontier
column6: we have publicly called for “pacing the frontier,”

column4: The S-1 says the pacing call does not describe Anthropic's own development or release timelines
column6: This call to pace the frontier contemplates frontier AI developers collaborating with governments and does not describe our own model development or release timelines, which continue to be informed by our risk assessments.

column4: The S-1 says the business model requires capital to stay at the frontier
column6: Our business model requires substantial and increasing capital to support our ability to remain competitive and to stay at the frontier of AI.

column4: RSP v3.4 Appendix A is titled Commitments Related to Competitors
column6: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors These commitments are necessarily high-level and limited.

column4: The RSP names the scenario Anthropic in the lead
The lead scenario requires clear evidence that no competitor will soon develop such a model
column6: clear evidence that no other competitor will soon develop such a model

column4: In the lead scenario, Anthropic delays only until it no longer believes it has a significant lead
column6: We will delay AI development and deployment as needed to achieve this, until and unless we no longer believe we have a significant lead.

column4: Where a competitor has a better mitigation, Anthropic will not necessarily delay
column6: we will not necessarily delay AI development and deployment in this scenario

column4: The appendix says the commitments do not preclude cautionary action
column6: do not preclude us from taking cautionary action

column4: The appendix says Anthropic would strongly consider pausing even in cases not covered
column6: would strongly consider pausing development and/or deployment to improve the safety profiles of our models even in cases not covered below.
